import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the a11yproject.com project details using the knowledge base function
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, "The A11Y Project / a11yproject.com")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Click on the issues link for this project
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="42", exact=True)
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Find the issue with '404' in its title
    all_links = await page.get_by_role("link").all()
    target_issue_link = None
    for link in all_links:
        text = await link.text_content()
        if '404' in text:
            target_issue_link = link
            break
    if not target_issue_link:
        raise Exception("Issue with '404' not found")
    await target_issue_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 4: Assign the issue to myself
    assign_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Assign", exact=False)
    if await assign_button.count() > 0:
        await assign_button.click()
        myself_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="myself", exact=False)
        if await myself_option.count() > 0:
            await myself_option.click()
    else:
        assign_select = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Assignee", exact=False)
        if await assign_select.count() > 0:
            await assign_select.select_option(label="myself")
        else:
            assignee_area = page.get_by_text("Assignee", exact=False)
            if await assignee_area.count() > 0:
                await assignee_area.click()
                myself_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="myself", exact=False)
                if await myself_option.count() > 0:
                    await myself_option.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Task should be complete after assignment
    return "Issue regarding 404 in a11yproject assigned to myself."
